Considered under suspension of the rules. (consideration: CR H1930-1932)

dimensions.assessment: Affects surviving spouses, children, dependent parents, or estates of veterans who die after being awarded a pension but before receiving payment.
dimensions.evidence: paid to the first living person or entity listed below: (1) The veteran's spouse. (2) The veteran's children

dimensions.assessment: Effects are procedural and administrative regarding the distribution of already-awarded pension funds.
dimensions.evidence: establishes procedures for the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) to issue a pension that was due but unpaid

dimensions.assessment: No new federal spending or revenue changes are stated; it governs the disbursement of funds already authorized or owed.
Amends Title 38 of the United States Code to add specific payout procedures and extend a minor limit on pension payments.
dimensions.evidence: Chapter 51 of title 38, United States Code, is amended by inserting, after section 5121A, the following new section

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory change applying to deaths occurring on or after the date of enactment.
dimensions.evidence: The amendments made by this section shall apply with respect to the death of a veteran that occurs on or after the date of the enactment of this Act.

missing_information: Exact number of veterans or families affected annually
Total monetary value of the unpaid pensions involved
importance_detail.rationale: This bill establishes a specific administrative hierarchy for the Department of Veterans Affairs to distribute unpaid pensions owed to deceased veterans. While it affects surviving spouses, children, dependent parents, or estates of certain deceased veterans, its scope is narrow and procedural.
